responsibility: This module provides the GNU Modula-2 mc bootstrap chain support library: a small C/C++ runtime scaffold that lets bootstrap-generated Modula-2 code link, initialize, and use essential host services before the full runtime is available. Its files are dominated by wrapper layers that expose C library, math, errno, dtoa/ldtoa conversion, network byte-order, select-based I/O multiplexing, termios terminal control, Unix argument/environment access, and miscellaneous OS utilities to Modula-2 code, alongside runtime support for module registration and static initialization ordering, language-defined termination paths, and signal-to-exception hookup. It also includes dummy or minimal implementations of core modules such as SYSTEM and Builtins plus public headers that define the bootstrap interfaces, constants, and helper entry points used by generated code. Overall, this directory is the bootstrap-specific Modula-2 runtime bridge between front-end generated code and the host operating system, distinct from the main compiler proper by focusing on low-level runtime linkage, host interop, and fallback support logic needed during the mc boot process.
